hook: *38* raids, *1,424* bank accounts frozen: India hits a Myanmar-border drug network
tldr: Operation Trident: the NCB, police and ED raided 38 locations in Assam, Mizoram and Manipur on Oct 23. 18 arrested, ₹100 crore in hawala traced, 1,424 bank accounts frozen, ₹17.82 crore in assets attached, 500 detonators seized.

beats.what: Raids hit Aizawl, Champhai and Zokhawthar (Mizoram), Churachandpur (Manipur) and the Cachar corridor (Assam).
beats.why: The network moved drugs across India, Myanmar and Bangladesh via the 'Death Triangle Corridor', with money laundered through hawala.
beats.care: Amit Shah's target: eradicate every drug network by Dec 31, 2029. Meanwhile Congress is demanding the Manipur CM resign over renewed violence (about 300 killed since May 2023).

cards.caption: hawala money traced
cards.body: Plus ₹12 lakh cash and 500 detonators seized.
